from pagination import paginate


def test_page_two_size_two_returns_third_and_fourth_items():
    # Literal issue input passed unchanged: range(1, 8).
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 2, 2)
    assert result == [3, 4]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_first_page_returns_first_items():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 1, 2)
    assert result == [1, 2]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_last_full_page_returns_trailing_items():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 4, 2)
    assert result == [7]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_beyond_last_page_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 5, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_empty_input_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate([], 1, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_invalid_page_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate([1, 2], 0, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_invalid_page_size_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate([1, 2], 1, 0)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_list_input_returns_list_slice():
    result = paginate([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], 2, 2)
    assert result == [3, 4]
    assert isinstance(result, list)
